_note: Axis-A color conformance under a PERCEPTUAL color-loss metric: the analyzer decodes the OUTPUT by its own embedded tag and the SOURCE forced to its matrix/range (fixtures carry only a matrix tag), then asks 'does the export SHOW the same colors as the source?'. 709ltd + 601ltd are FAITHFUL (worst_app_max <= faithfulMax): the export decode side honors the source matrix end-to-end -- the decoder config is tagged via withDefaultColorSpace + the ffprobe source color (T1-T6), the decoder emits a correctly-tagged frame, and VideoClipSprite converts it through a colorSpace-honoring 2D drawImage instead of Pixi's copyExternalImageToTexture (which ignores VideoFrame.colorSpace). The WebCodecs HD encoder (HW and SW) ignores the input frame colorSpace and writes a resolution default, so every HD output is bt709-tagged: a 601 source is faithfully NORMALIZED to 709 with only codec round-trip loss (601ltd=2). 709full/601full stay KNOWN-BAD: their output is limited-range (tv) while the source is full-range (pc) -- a real pc->tv squash verified via ffprobe (suspected cause: the full-range proxy re-encode drops full range, not directly confirmed this session) -- a real loss the original-decode path doesn't touch (deferred proxy-color slice); when that lands their error drops <= faithfulMax and the >5 assertion flips red. (Prior notes blaming 'decoder ignores config.colorSpace' or 'Pixi drops the matrix' as the whole story were over-reads: the decoder DOES honor config -- frame verified tagged smpte170m -- Pixi's UPLOAD was the decode-side culprit, now fixed, and the output TAG is the encoder resolution-default, not fixable in the web framework.)

709full.known_cause: VERIFIED via ffprobe: source is full-range (pc) but the output is limited-range (tv) -- a real pc->tv squash. SUSPECTED cause: full-range sources route through a proxy whose re-encode drops full range (not directly confirmed this session). Deferred proxy-color slice.

601full.known_cause: same observed pc->tv squash (+ 601 matrix); suspected proxy re-encode, unconfirmed; deferred proxy-color slice.
